content.user_title: Calculate Japan Post Postage and Yu-Pack Fees
content.value_statement: Japan Post fees depend on mail dimensions, weight, service options, and parcel origin. This skill calculates supported charges from dated tables and identifies missing information.
actual_capabilities: Classify standard and nonstandard letters by dimensions and weight, then calculate their base postage.
Look up postcard, mini-letter, Letter Pack, and Smart Letter prices and size or weight limits.
Add express, registered-mail, and delivery-record surcharges while checking supported option combinations.
Calculate Tokyo-origin Yu-Pack fares by parcel size and destination region, including the listed heavy-parcel surcharge.
Calculate stamp combinations that cover the full postage without understating the required charge.
Ask for missing measurements and include the applicable rate revision or verification date in answers.
limitations: Built-in Yu-Pack fares cover Tokyo departures only; other origins require the official calculator or an origin-specific table.
Yu-Mail base fares, international mail, and options outside the listed services are not supported.
Rates are embedded snapshots, not live data; future revisions require official verification and table updates.
Accurate estimates require packed dimensions, weight, and relevant locations; the skill does not purchase postage or arrange shipping.

use_cases.title: Estimate Letter Postage
use_cases.description: Check an envelope against size and weight limits, then calculate the required postage and a suitable stamp combination.

use_cases.title: Budget Parcel Shipping
use_cases.description: Estimate Tokyo-origin Yu-Pack costs from package measurements and destination regions before quoting shipping to customers.
use_cases.target_user: Small online sellers shipping from Tokyo

use_cases.title: Price Recorded Office Mail
use_cases.description: Compare supported registered-mail and delivery-record charges, including compatible express options, for outgoing documents.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Letter Postage
prompt_templates.prompt: My domestic envelope is 20 cm by 10 cm by 0.5 cm and weighs 30 g. Calculate postage and state the rate date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: calculate a single standard letter charge.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Mail Options
prompt_templates.prompt: My domestic envelope measures 30 by 20 by 2 cm and weighs 100 g. Compare express, simplified registered, and delivery-record charges, including valid combinations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare supported surcharges and compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate a Tokyo Parcel
prompt_templates.prompt: My parcel ships from Tokyo to Osaka, measures 30 by 25 by 20 cm, and weighs 5 kg. Calculate undiscounted Yu-Pack postage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: select a parcel size and destination region.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Batch Postage Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: For [mail items with dimensions, weights, destinations, and options], calculate individual charges, stamp combinations, and the batch total. Flag missing details and unsupported services.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine multiple estimates without guessing missing inputs.

output_examples.input: A domestic envelope measures 20 by 10 by 0.5 cm and weighs 30 g. What postage is required?
output: Classification: standard letter, within the 50 g limit.
Base postage: 110 yen. Stamp combination: one 110-yen stamp.

output_examples.input: Send a 100 g domestic envelope measuring 30 by 20 by 2 cm by express and simplified registered mail.
output: Classification: nonstandard letter within standard dimensions, up to 100 g.
Base postage: 180 yen. Express surcharge: 300 yen. Simplified registered surcharge: 350 yen.
Total: 830 yen. Express and simplified registered mail can be combined.
Rate basis: postal revision dated 2024-10-01; surcharges checked on 2026-09-19.

output_examples.input: Send a 5 kg parcel measuring 30 by 25 by 20 cm from Tokyo to Osaka, without discounts.
output: Combined dimensions: 75 cm. Yu-Pack size: 80. Destination region: Kinki.
Base fare: 1,440 yen according to the embedded Tokyo-origin table. No heavy-parcel surcharge applies.
Rate basis: Yu-Pack revision dated 2026-10-01, checked on 2026-10-13.

best_practices: Provide measurements and weight after packing, plus parcel origin and destination prefectures.
Specify required service options and check compatibility before adding their charges.
Keep the rate basis date in each estimate and verify official rates when revisions may apply.
anti_patterns: Applying Tokyo-origin Yu-Pack prices to parcels sent from another prefecture.
Combining registered mail with delivery-record service, which the skill explicitly disallows.
Guessing dimensions, weights, unsupported fees, or future rates to produce a complete-looking estimate.

faq.question: Does the skill require an API key or login?
faq.answer: No. Supported calculations use built-in tables without network access, API keys, or a Japan Post account.

faq.question: Are rates updated automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains dated rate tables and asks users to verify official pages when later changes may apply.

faq.question: Can it calculate Yu-Pack fares from any prefecture?
faq.answer: Only Tokyo-origin fares are embedded. For other origins, it directs users to the official calculator or the relevant origin-specific table.

faq.question: Which services are outside its scope?
faq.answer: Yu-Mail base fares, international mail, recipient-restricted delivery, content certification, and cash-on-delivery are outside the supported calculations.

faq.question: Can express delivery be combined with registered mail?
faq.answer: Yes. Express can accompany registered mail or delivery-record service, but registered mail and delivery-record service cannot be combined.

faq.question: What happens when dimensions or weight are missing?
faq.answer: The skill asks for missing details instead of guessing. Parcel estimates also require the origin and destination.
